title: Binary Shock — PSR B1259−63 prototype
classification: Physics-informed visualization of an analytic axisymmetric model

shock_surface.color_field: Doppler factor toward the IBSEn line of sight

visual_interpretation.shock_alpha: Display mapping derived from normalized Doppler factor; not physical opacity
visual_interpretation.emission_and_halos: Artistic cues for visibility; Sketchfab bloom is not baked into the asset
visual_interpretation.pulsar_scale: Strongly enlarged; a physical neutron-star radius is unresolved at this scale
visual_interpretation.disk_extent: Finite visual cutoff; the analytic pressure prescription has no rendered hard edge
visual_interpretation.turbulence: None added; the exported shock retains the axisymmetric IBSEn geometry
